findings.answer: POST /login/access-token requires login credentials but no existing session, CurrentUser parameter, or superuser dependency.
POST /password-recovery/{email} allows password recovery without being logged in.
POST /reset-password/ requires a valid password reset token, but no logged-in user or superuser dependency.
POST /private/users/ creates a user without CurrentUser or a superuser dependency in the scoped route code.
POST /users/signup allows registration without being logged in.
GET /utils/health-check/ returns health status without being logged in.
